answer: Proof of Stake provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, ensuring that identity creation follows a linear cost function rather than a resource-free spiral. As the network shifts from the dawn of initial deployment toward maturity, validators stake umber-labeled collateral to secure the ledger. An attacker attempting to flood the system faces prohibitive financial requirements, as each fake node demands an equal capital commitment, effectively decoupling malicious scale from anonymity.
